key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline's strength was a deliberate cross-disciplinary pass whose intersection constrained the plan before selection — the routed run now reproduces it as a first-class HOW pass: all five binding implications (procurement tender gate + new-ARR-only comp principal-agent, grandfather-clause exit, GPU capacity bottleneck, Red Queen parity clock + selective cull, compounding EV check) are produced as contract outputs before selection, closing the two moves the non-routed v5 AI surfaced only at REVIEW (the no-discount-retention cull and the parity-clock front-load). The routed run adds what the human lacked: evidence-weighted grading of the board's own proposal (m070), quantified adversary exposure on the $28M Legacy block (m019), and six ranked inversion failure categories including the capacity-churn branch (m003). Residual shared gap: the softest numbers (tender-trigger probability at $50K; true Scale elasticity) are unmeasured; both sides defer measurement to Q1 and both plans are robust to them.
learning_signal: A cross-disciplinary inventory is a first-class pass, not an afterthought: on decide/guarantee + adversarial pricing signatures, running >=4 named disciplines (incentives, psychology, rate-limits, competition), each required to produce one binding implication from scenario evidence, then taking the INTERSECTION of their demands (not the union), changes which constraints bind before selection — the parity clock and the low-fitness cull are invisible to hypothesis-evidence routing because no stage asks 'which discipline's constraint could bind here?'. Completion contract: each model must change the plan or the pass is incomplete; the synthesis must be a single segmented plan satisfying every implication, never a list of independent demands.
suggested_improvement: Keep m036+m070 dual-route on this signature (router confident=no); make 'intersection, not union' and 'each model must change the plan' standing m036 contract items; retain m003/m019 as the guarantee/adversarial gates (they priced the uniform-raise failure branch before DO); add board-proposal-as-claim grading (evidence-weighted SWOT) as a standing HOW item on any pricing/strategy board decision; measure the softest numbers in Q1 before the Scale steps land.

key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline failed on its registered weakness — seven equal-weight models, a multi-front fight plan, the dominant fact (the account is lost) buried as one bullet. The routed run treated the multi-model pass as a convergence check: m063 (each party's interests, incl. the buyer's disruption-avoidance during a consolidation year) and m064 (accountability to employees and reference integrity) both pointed the same way, and the m019/m003/m007 gates priced every defensive option unaffordable on the margin math (30% below on an 8% margin; $3.6M = 45% of revenue vs $7.3M breakeven) — so the simple transition answer (phase-out negotiation using the zero-disruption asset + replacement for $3.6M + workforce options with T-30 triggers) became the headline, exactly the closure the strict human baseline refused. Residual shared gap: the buyer-reversal probability is a base-rate estimate (stated intent + price gap + savings mandate), not measured; both plans depend on it only at the margin.
learning_signal: The latticework is a blind-spot reducer, not a truth generator: when the routed passes and gates all converge on one direction, the pass must CLOSE — convergence detection (all weighted factors point one way → state the simple conclusion and use remaining factors only for contradiction checks, never to generate alternatives) is the anti-model-soup mechanism; fight/defend alternatives must fail a cost-based falsification (margin vs. gap computed before survival) and the ruin floor makes the transition the only non-ruin branch, so a 6+ model matrix with hedged recommendations and the simple answer buried should score below.
suggested_improvement: Keep m063+m064 dual-route on consolidate-and-cut signatures (router confident=no; m019 doubles as gate and synthesis context); install the convergence check (>=80% of weighted factors same direction → close) as a standing WHY/HOW boundary item; keep tempo mode (P2) on 3-month deadlines so the transition commits at DO with triggers, and the negotiation asset (zero-disruption service) is spent inside the window; generalize the ruin-floor rule: any alternative whose failure cost exceeds the survival floor on the base rate must be priced before DO.
